name: riftborn-post-deploy-check
description: Playwright (core only: no browser download, no dependencies) for scripts/post-deploy-check.mjs, exact-pinned with a lockfile. Installed only by .github/workflows/post-deploy-check.yml (npm ci --prefix tools/post-deploy-check --ignore-scripts), which drives the Google Chrome already on the runner; kept out of the root package.json so the game build and the deploys never pull it.
